label: A concrete thing that begins to be present has a concrete CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, a concrete thing absent at a moment s and present at a strictly later moment t has some concrete CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause, one that gives it being at every moment at which it is present. Things never absent before being present are unconstrained. Contested by existential inertia (Schmid 2021), which denies that a persisting thing needs a sustaining cause; an inertialist can grant the originating counterpart.
